exposure: Ultrasound-guided local methotrexate (25 mg fixed dose)
outcome: Beta human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) clearance duration
cohort: The study included 46 patients diagnosed with uterine ectopic pregnancies, specifically interstitial, cervical, or cesarean scar pregnancies.
finding: In patients with uterine ectopic pregnancies, the mean estimated beta hCG clearance duration was 29.2 days longer when local methotrexate was applied compared with systemic methotrexate.
followup_time: Until beta hCG clearance, which averaged 64.7 days for local methotrexate and 31.5 days for systemic methotrexate.
